turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, Dr. Smith. I came in because I just can't keep my mind on my actual experiments anymore. It's becoming a real problem at the lab. 

I'll be in the middle of an important grant call or a safety meeting, and I'll notice a pump vibrating, or one of the students will make some random side comment, or I'll suddenly think about an odd peak in an old spectrum. And then I'm just... gone. I'll go off chasing that one tiny detail for hours, completely sidetracked, while the actual work everyone needs from me just falls apart.
